d: Platinum white hair is styled with thick, braided twin tails and long, sweeping bangs. Golden-amber eyes are wide and cheerful on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in a black and dark grey tactical outfit consisting of a high-collar sleeveless top over long sleeves, short shorts, and a yellow utility belt with various pouches and a black shoulder bag. A single black mechanical headset with a yellow triangle is worn on the left side of the head.
